comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** No defects found at `4ecd694`.

Follow-up to the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13345#issuecomment-5852564293) and [reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13345#issuecomment-5871888457); since `552b1dd` only the code comment changed.

**Earlier notes:**
- **No-pager result:** still holds; re-run at the new head.
- **Premise precision:** resolved; the new comment matches git's default `LESS=FRX`.
- **`omarchy update` path:** still accurate, plus one addition: open #10326 would run `omarchy-plugin-update` without `--yes` from attended `omarchy update` runs, on the `script` pseudo-terminal, so this fix covers that call too.
- **Overlapping PRs:** unchanged. #10711, #10248 and #11242 still use a plain `git diff` there, none carries `--no-pager`, and each conflicts with this PR.

<details><summary>Details</summary>

Pseudo-terminal runs (24x80, git 2.55.0, less 704, gum 2.0.0, `delta` branch forced off, synthetic plugin one commit behind upstream):

```text
lines replaced, setup                        base                         head
3, LESS unset                                less quits, prompt visible   no pager, prompt visible
100, LESS unset                              prompt hidden until q        no pager, prompt visible
3, LESS=R                                    prompt hidden until q        no pager, prompt visible
3, core.pager and pager.diff = less -+F      prompt hidden until q        no pager, prompt visible
```

At the head, answering `y` updated the plugin, and git's colour was kept.

- **#10326:** merges cleanly into current `quattro`. Its `bin/omarchy-update` calls `omarchy-plugin-update || true` only when `OMARCHY_UPDATE_UNATTENDED` is unset, so `omarchy update -y` skips it.
- **#11242:** has a second plain `git diff`, in its new `pin_to_commit()` path. All three conflict with this PR in `bin/omarchy-plugin-update`.
- **Unchanged files:** `bin/omarchy-plugin-update`, `bin/omarchy-update` and `bin/omarchy-hook` are unchanged between this PR's parent and current `quattro`; the `--no-pager` line is identical to `552b1dd`.
- **Optional:** the PR description still says "Same one-word change" and that a `post-update.d` hook calls `omarchy-plugin-update`. The reply now says such a hook would be a user's own. Updating the description would keep both in line for a reader who skips the thread.
</details>
